text:
Ava: quick UX check — attaching latest build of the routing policies editor. small batch of things I noticed in the rules list and preview flow.

Jon: sending a quick screenshot in thread, thanks. main concern?

Ava: main stuff: (1) inline validation copy is confusing when multiple rules conflict, (2) drag handle isn't keyboard accessible, (3) preview simulation hides which fallback route triggered.

Priya: +1 on the validation copy. example: when two rules have same priority we show 'Conflict' — should we spell out 'Two rules have the same priority; results may be nondeterministic'?

Sam: agree. current copy: "Priority conflict" is terse. proposed: "Two rules share the same priority. Reorder or set explicit priorities to ensure deterministic routing." less alarmist and actionable.

Ava: exactly. And add a tiny link "Learn about priority ordering" that opens side panel.

Theo: keyboard/aria note: drag handle (⋮) has no tabindex and no aria-label. For keyboard reordering we should support up/down arrows on focused rule row and expose aria-live announcements for order change. a11y-bot: recommended pattern: aria-grabbed + keyboard move or use roving tabindex with move actions.

a11y-bot: Suggestion: add a hidden label 'Move rule up' / 'Move rule down' on the handle buttons and ensure role="button". Announce: "Rule 'US Premium' moved to position 2 of 4" via aria-live="polite".

Priya: for preview simulation: we currently show "Matched: model-x" but not which fallback was used or why. Can we expand preview to show the full evaluation path: matched conditions -> matched route -> fallback chain? small chevron to expand details.

Jon: +1. Also when preview runs against sample input, show the specific request fields that matched (e.g., header X-Region: eu-west-1) — testers keep guessing which field triggered the route.

Sam: UX nit: the rule list baseline spacing makes it hard to scan priority numbers. can we left-align the priority chip and increase contrast? current chip is 8px, low contrast.

Ava: copy tweaks for validation modals: current modal title "Invalid rule" -> change to "Rule validation issues" and use bulleted list like: "• Condition 'country' is empty" "• Priority is duplicated with rule 'A'". Provide inline quick actions: "Fix" next to each bullet to open editor anchored.

Theo: performance note: the preview simulation is expensive when we evaluate 50 sample inputs. suggestion: show top 3 matches by default and a 'Run full sweep (50)' button.

Priya: one more accessibility point — color-only state for disabled rules. We should add an icon and text hint "Disabled" and ensure the contrast ratio of disabled state meets AA.

Ava: next steps: Priya + Theo to draft exact validation copy and a11y annotations, Sam to mock spacing/contrast tweaks, Jon to update preview detail expansion interactions. I'll collect small copy + aria string file and iterate.

Jon: I'll PR the preview expansion tomorrow and include sample payload that shows matched fields.

Sam: I'll prototype the left-aligned priority chip and increase the interactive target of drag handle to 24px.

Priya: working on clear copy suggestions now, will drop in Figma by EOD.

Ava: thanks team — going to tag this as a follow-up in the design board and assign tasks. :thumbsup:

Jon: yay. small followup: can we add a tooltip on hover for the priority explanation ("Lower number = higher priority" or whatever mapping we decide)? saves confusion.

Ava: yes — tooltip + help link in the editor header.

Theo: noted. I'll add aria-describedby linking the tooltip to the priority control.

Ava: cool, closing thread for now. we can reopen if QA finds more issues. :rocket:
